responsibility: This file implements the mc-boot runtime's fixed-buffer string utility routines. It provides concatenation, lexical comparison, equality, length calculation, bounded copying, substring search, and leading-whitespace stripping over nul-terminated character arrays, serving as the basic array-string manipulation layer beneath both higher-level DynamicStrings code and many parsing and I/O helpers.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation half of the GStrLib pair: it contains the concrete fixed-buffer string algorithms such as comparison, length, copy, concatenation, substring search, and whitespace stripping, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GStrLib.h only defines the API surface for those helpers.
